about.metaDescription: Physiotherapist Julia Pilch on her approach, background, and clinical experience across orthopaedics, sport, and rehabilitation.

hero.heading: About me
intro: Helping people regain their independence and confidence is what drew me to physiotherapy. I focus on treating causes rather than simply managing symptoms, because long-term results come from understanding why a problem developed in the first place. Every patient has their own story, goals, and needs, so I listen first and then build a plan that fits them, whether they are recovering from surgery, returning to sport, or rebuilding confidence in their body.

Movement has always been an important part of my life. Outside the clinic, I spend a lot of time strength training, doing CrossFit, running, and staying active in different ways. This helps me understand how important movement is for both physical and mental well-being, and it strongly influences the way I work with patients. I believe rehabilitation should not only reduce pain, but also help people feel stronger, safer, and more confident in their bodies.
